ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) base with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity circular rings distributed across both lobes; a dense cluster of white high-intensity pixels on the medial section of the right lobe; low-intensity pixels form the primary background of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with low-amplitude peaks along the inner trailing edge and high-amplitude irregular jagged peaks at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending to pointed distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white rings (approx. 15-20 visible) representing barnacle attachment sites, clustered mostly in the central fluke region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several white linear disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths, predominantly visible on the right lobe and central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of both circular scarring (rosettes) and linear abrasions (rake marks) across the visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A large, irregular high-intensity white patch on the dorsal-medial portion of the right lobe near the median notch.
